_instructions: Copy for the site-wide enquiry form. One dialog renders on every page (Base.astro). Any button or card can open it with data-enquire-reason (why), data-enquire (which equipment) and data-enquire-label (the exact button text). The equipment dropdown is assembled in src/lib/content.ts from products.json, store.json and third-party.json — add equipment there, not here. Add a new reason below and any trigger can use its id immediately.
heading: Tell Us What You Need
body: A few details and we'll come back with real numbers and what it takes to run it.
_note_on_reason: The reason is never asked. It is a hidden field, set from the data-enquire-reason on whatever was clicked, or at build time by a page form. The list below is the allowed set — the dialog drops anything not in it.
